name: Kassandra
bio: Archetype: Assassination, Gash, Extra Action, Ultimate. ⌽ Gains [Adrenaline] instead of Moxie. With enough [Adrenaline], generates a versatile attack card with special effects. ⌽ S2 inflicts [Lethal Injury], causing attacks to trigger [Assassination], or enhancing its effects if the attack is an [Assassination]. ⌽ Utilizes a skill tree mechanic for kit customization. ⌽ [Hunter] branch grants Crit Rate and Crit DMG to all allies, and improves [Lethal Injury] and [Assassination] capabilities. ⌽ [Warrior] branch grants DMG Bonus and Incantation Might to all allies, and improves extra action and [Gash] capabilities. ⌽ [Assassin] branch grants ATK and Pen. Rate to all allies, gain additional casts of [Rush Assassination], and improves [Adrenaline] gain. ⌽ Insight 3 grants [Guidance of Three Gods] whenever an ally triggers an [Assassination], enhancing the effects of the current forcefield.
